utterances.speaker: MS. UERTZ-RETZLAFF
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. The Prosecution had intended to call the witness Osman Subasic on background facts, actually, and we have reached an agreement with Defence counsel that this is not necessary. We have agreed that only his transcript from the Kunarac case where he has testified as a witness should be entered into evidence, including some of the reports that were exhibits while he gave this testimony. And the Defence does not want to cross-examine this witness, so we can deal with him in a written format and do not have to call him. And the exhibits that we would like to enter are in the trial binders that you have in front of you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Does that include the transcript of his evidence?

utterances.speaker: MS. UERTZ-RETZLAFF
utterances.text: It is the transcript which has now the identification number 286, and then following the reports, having the identification numbers 286 -- 287, 287A, 288 and 288A, 289, 289A, 290, 290A, 291, and 291A. And the exhibit -- and the document ID number 287 and 287A were in the Kunarac case entered under seal because the name of one of the witnesses in that trial was on the document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Those are the only ones that have to go in under seal, are they?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Are you happy with that, Mr. Bakrac?

utterances.speaker: MR. BAKRAC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, by your leave, I would like to remind the accused of what this is all about - we had already discussed it before - and then I can respond.

utterances.speaker: MR. BAKRAC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour, we have no objections, and we have agreed on this with the Prosecutors already.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: I congratulate the parties on having got rid of at least one witness. Therefore the documents will be admitted as Exhibits P286, 287, 287A, 288, 288A, 289, 289A, 290, 290A, 291, and 291A. Exhibits P87 -- I'm sorry, P287 and 287A will be under seal.

utterances.speaker: MS. UERTZ-RETZLAFF
utterances.text: Your Honour, we can continue if you like with the witness Dr. Berberkic today, but he is not yet in the room here, in the witness waiting room, but he can be here in a few minutes. It's up to you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Today is a rather sensitive day for us all. I think it might be a good idea if we came back in the morning. We did say to him we'd see him again on Thursday. Perhaps it might be said to be, as gently as possible, that our attention may be wandering slightly at this time. We'll adjourn now and we'll resume again at 9.30 tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: be reconvened on Thursday, the 15th day of March, 2001, at 9.30 a.m. 20 21 22 23 24 25 Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts.
